title: Reflection
description: Structured prompts, and the participant's own words extracted from them. R4 B3.

text.description: ★ THE PARTICIPANT'S OWN WORDS. Never a selection from options we wrote — a reflection assembled from our sentences reflects us.

quality.description: ⚠️ Q20 owes the mechanism. Recognition is for the QUALITY OF INQUIRY, never for the safety state described — DEC-005. Null until Q20 closes.

$comment: There is no `score` property, and additionalProperties is false. A number attached to a person's reflection about their own hospital is the exact behaviour DEC-005 exists to prevent.
